text:
nina_cs: Heads-up — Aurora Labs tripped APAC demo limits during POC. Theyre asking for a short allowlist + temporary qps bump for their demo nodes (45.33.120.0/29). Renewal in 4 weeks, want to avoid a bad demo.
ryan_ops: Got it. Which APAC region do they prefer?
leo_net: They requested tokyo (ap-northeast-1). Sent two egress IPs 45.33.120.2 and 45.33.120.3 — prefer whitelisting those specifically.
nina_cs: Customer note: "expected bursts up to 500 rps for 90m; request soft=3000 qps for demo window, please."
ryan_ops: Proposed: soft=3000, hard=3800, autorevoke=36h, 24h pre-revoke notice. Need eng-infra approval for region pin + proxy ACL.
leo_net: Action checklist for infra: add CIDR 45.33.120.0/29 to tenant allowlist; set tenant.aurora soft=3000 hard=3800; schedule autorevoke @36h; smoke test from 45.33.120.2.
ops-bot: ops-bot: draft change created 2025-10-12T01:00:00Z — status: pending-approval. Summary: allowlist 45.33.120.0/29, soft=3000, hard=3800, autorevoke=36h, region pin ap-northeast-1.
zoe_renewals: Flagging renewals — demo outcome has direct renewal impact. Please capture post-demo feedback and token-cost summary.
ryan_ops: ENGOPS-6123 opened: "aurora-labs: ap-northeast-1 temp allowlist + qps bump" https://redwood.internal/ops/ENGOPS-6123
leo_net: Test snippet to validate allowlist when live: curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Forwarded-For: 45.33.120.2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/healthcheck (expect 200)
ryan_ops: Rollback criteria: sustained p50 latency > 500ms or error rate > 2% -> revert and notify CS + customer. Will post results after deploy.
nina_cs: Thanks everyone. Please post status updates here and include the 24h revoke notice to customer. :thumbsup:
